notes.title: Update 0.9.1c
notes.notes:
That was some interesting work, to make the entire game compatible with multiple languages!
If your language is not represented in the game, but you'd like to - give us a shout on our discord, all translation help is welcome :)

* Made all text components compatible for multiple languages
* Already had English, but now added Brazilian-Portuguese, Thai and Dutch
* Simplified Chinese WIP
* added a credits screen, accessible through main menu. Now the proper parties can recieve kudos :)
* QOL: changed colors of buttons w.r.t. selection and default around, making the colors more intuitive when used for tabs (think high scores etc).
* FIX: in post-battle, the popup menu's 'save & back to menu' didn't work properly.

notes.title: Update 0.8.8
notes.notes:
- enhance colors for the zombies, making them stand out more with their pretty clothes
- fix for horizontal match of 4 not always clearing the swapped tile
- make tiles drop nicely from above, no more 'folding out'
- fix for linux slow block dropping
- fix menu behavior in post-battle (there was no escape. Now there  is. Or is there?)
